title: a label GitHub takes off and answers with a server error or with no answer at all, as a release takes it off, is not put back with the labels the run took off before it, so the held claim's issue is left without it
status: fixed after 0.5.0: a release that fails taking a label off puts back the label whose removal failed with those it took off, unless GitHub refused it with a 4xx other than a rate limit's, on a try that followed none refused for a rate limit, which says it took nothing off, since a server error or no answer at all may come after GitHub took it, and putting back a label still on changes nothing (github.take_labels_off, github.release_one; DESIGN.md, 13)

steps.note: a's claim has had no commit for 25 hours, so the coordinator releases it: GitHub takes claimed off and answers 502, so the run fails at the labels, posts no comment and puts claimed back, since GitHub may have taken it, and the issue is as the run found it. Until the fix the run put back only the labels GitHub had answered, none here, so #1 carried worker:a without claimed while a held the claim
the next run releases a's claim whole and renames the branch, so #1 is in the Queue again; b's claim, idle 24 hours, is held
b's claim has had no commit for 25 hours: GitHub takes claimed off and the connection times out before any answer, so again the run puts claimed back with the labels it took off, none
the next run releases b's claim whole

c's claim is due: GitHub refuses to take claimed off with a 422, which it answers in place of taking it off, so claimed is still on and the run puts back nothing, having taken nothing off; a run that put claimed back too would write a label the issue carries, and say, were that write refused, that a label still on may be off
the next run releases c's claim whole

d's claim is due: GitHub refuses claimed's removal for a rate limit though it takes the label off, the client waits a minute and asks again, and GitHub answers 404, the label being off; then it answers worker:d's removal 500. The 404 follows a try that may have taken claimed off, so the run counts claimed as taken off and puts it back with worker:d. Until F27's review the run read the 404 as a label #4 never carried, put back worker:d alone and left claimed off the held claim's issue
the next run releases d's claim whole
